## 🔬 Foundational Contextual Portfolio (Pre-2025)

Our research group maps the Green Digital Transformation (GDT) trajectory, evolving from high-level carbon metrics to operational ecosystem design. The socio-technical foundations of our work are grounded in the initial scientometric analysis of carbon neutrality policies [@Zhang-2021-Carbon_Neutrality] and the subsequent development of resilience taxonomies for global supply chains [@Pan-2023-Supply_Chain_Resilience; @Liao-2023-Intelligent_Ports]. We have since operationalized these frameworks through smart digital platforms for carbon-neutral service design [@Liao-2023-SmartDigitalPlatforms] and ESG capability building via partner maps [@Liao-2023-Collaborating_ESG_Consulting], culminating in our integrated framework for ecosystem-inspired sustainable innovation [@Liao-2024-Digital_Transformation_Innovation_Ecosystems].
